commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create inventory-api application =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import json
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = {
    "widgets": 120,
    "gadgets": 45,
    "gizmos": 300,
}
START = time.time()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json(200, {"status": "ok", "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1)})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json(200, INVENTORY)
        else:
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /opt/inventory-api/app.py

echo "== STEP 2: create dedicated service user =="
if ! id inventoryapi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventoryapi
fi
sudo -n chown -R inventoryapi:inventoryapi /opt/inventory-api

echo "== STEP 3: create systemd unit with OOM protection =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service > /dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventoryapi
Group=inventoryapi
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
# Shield this service from the kernel OOM killer: the more negative,
# the less likely this process is chosen when memory is exhausted.
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
OOMPolicy=continue

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

echo "== STEP 4: enable and start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-api

sleep 1
echo "== STEP 5: verify service state =="
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-api
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-api
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-api --no-pager | head -15

echo "== STEP 6: verify oom_score_adj applied =="
PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-api)
echo "MainPID=$PID"
cat /proc/$PID/oom_score_adj
cat /proc/$PID/oom_score

echo "== STEP 7: verify API responds =="
curl -s "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"; echo
curl -s "http://$NODE_IP:8080/inventory"; echo
